newsitem.title: USA: Iridex says CFO Marcotte resigns.
newsitem.headline: Iridex says CFO Marcotte resigns.

text.p: Iridex Corp on Thursday said Chief Financial Officer Timothy Marcotte has resigned from the company, effective December 27, to take a similar job at InfoGain Inc, a privately held software consulting firm.

In a statement, the company said former chief financial officer, James Donovan, has been named to replace Marcotte. Donovan has been a business development advisor to Iridex and member of the company's board of directors.
